data.title: Govt seeks special employee holiday for flood-hit businesses
data.description: The Department of Labour Protection and Welfare (DLPW) is asking businesses in Bangkok, Nonthaburi, Pathum Thani and Samut Prakan to declare Sept 28 and 29 as special holidays for employees facing the chaotic flooding in Bangkok.

data.title: Taylor Swift sets new record at MTV VMAs
data.description: LOS ANGELES - Taylor Swift is having another good year -- just months after her lavish wedding to Travis Kelce, the pop superstar on Sunday made history by becoming the most awarded artist at the MTV Video Music Awards.

data.title: Jet ski 'drifter' surfing Bangkok flood faces charges
data.description: A man who rode a jet ski through Bangkok floodwaters, deliberately making waves along submerged Phetchaburi Road on Sunday evening, was later arrested and charged with causing a public nuisance.

data.title: Eastern rail track partially reopens, airport link unaffected
data.description: Some train services resumed on the eastern line on Monday morning, but trains were still unable to reach flooded central Bangkok.

data.title: Seoul seeks apology after Ukraine reveals transfer of North Korean POWs
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's presidential office has demanded an apology from Ukraine for denying an agreement to keep the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul confidential.

data.title: 'Currently impossible': North Korea defections in freefall
data.description: PAJU (SOUTH KOREA) - A building-sized North Korean flag waves from a tower on the de facto border with South Korea, marking territory that experts say has become nearly impossible to escape.

data.title: Pseudo-journalism: Partisan 'news' sites target US midterms
data.description: WASHINGTON - It bills itself as an "independent journalism" outfit, but the innocuous-sounding North Carolinian is among hundreds of partisan sites that researchers say masquerade as local news outlets in battleground states ahead of the US midterm elections.

data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Siti ⁠Hasmah Mohamad Ali, the wife ​of Malaysia's longest-serving prime minister Mahathir Mohamad, died on Monday, ​the veteran leader's office said.

data.title: True Digital Park’s “Hello, Connecting to New Possibilities” Wins Influencer Award
data.description: Reinforcing its role as a tech and startup ecosystem that connects people, businesses, and opportunities from around the world, True Digital Park, Southeast Asia’s largest tech and startup hub, has won the Best Property & Real Estate Influencer Campaign at the Thailand Influencer Awards 2026, recognising the success of its “Hello, Connecting to New Possibilities” campaign. Built around the simple yet powerful idea of “Hello” as the starting point for new connections, the campaign highlights how meaningful connections can open doors to new opportunities, support business growth, expand partnerships, and strengthen the technology community. It also reflects True Digital Park’s role as a hub that brings together people, businesses, technology, and new possibilities under the concept of “One Roof, All Possibilities”.

data.title: Thailand proud! Central celebrates Nene Royal — 1st Thai to win America’s Got Talent
data.description: Central Pattana Plc has joined Thailand in celebrating 16-year-old Phuket native Rattikan “Praew” Amloy, better known as Nene Royal, who made history as the first Thai winner of America’s Got Talent Season 21 (2026).

data.title: AIA Thailand Partners with Healthcare Accreditation Institute (Public Organization)
data.description: AIA Thailand has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Healthcare Accreditation Institute (Public Organization) to strengthen healthcare quality standards and enhance value-based healthcare service delivery across Thailand. The signing ceremony was attended by the executives, including Dr. Benjapol Engkaninan, Associate Director, Head of Health Strategy, AIA Thailand, and Dr. Piyawan Limpanyalert, CEO of the Healthcare Accreditation Institute (Public Organization).
